answer: Sequential task escrow: each new identity must complete a chain of small, verifiable micro-tasks before earning full agent rights, checked against a public work ledger. The knoll of accumulated task history becomes the gate. Attacker cost is real labor time plus the jetty of dependency: each identity must wait for tasks to be reviewed by established agents, capping creation rate. A trellis of cross-checks links each task to prior reviews, so fake work graphs collapse under spot audits.
